title: David NDE 3405
content: I woke up with a feeling like heart burn in the middle of my chest at 6 am. Spent three hours trying to make it go away when I decided to go to emergency room. Got to emergency room and they made arrangements to fly me there by helicopter to the Cath Lab for surgery. Went into surgery and saw my heart on a monitor being pumped with some kind of dye. Passed out and had the NDE. I found myself in God's presence. No light, just a soft grey haze around everywhere. Jesus put His hand on my right should and said 'This one belongs to Me'. I was informed that it was not my time yet. I could go back but the choice was mine to make. I was welcome there, but must chose what I want to do. Feeling safe and loved and all knowledge available. No secrets. No wanting for anything. Very safe from any harm. I found myself waking up in the recovery room with nurses and doctors by my side. Everything haze with a glow around it. I did not feel like myself anymore. Like a stranger in a different place I did not belong. My body felt like someone else's body.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Heart attack Other Massive heart attack. Left side of heart not functioning. Blood clot. Massive heart attack.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal As soon as I arrived in the presence of God.
elements.At what time during the experience were: As soon as I arrived in the presence of God.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time had no value as it does here.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I could see anywhere I wanted to just with a thought.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Dimension.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future Very hard to explain. Hard for me to comprehend.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Conservative/fundamentalist Christion. Believe in God and Jesus.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes Do not fear death any longer, but long to return from where I came.
elements.What is your religion now?: Conservative/fundamentalist Christion. Believe in God and Jesus.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Do not fear death any longer, but long to return from where I came.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I seem to be able to see through lies and tell if someone means me harm from a long way away.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I seem to be able to see through lies and tell if someone means me harm from a long way away. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes Communication was done with thought and not words. Normal English vocabulary not necessary.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I can hear birds makes sense out of chirping. Animals really like me now. Really hard to explain.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: it was all significant to me..!!
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes My wife, and one friend. My wife just passed away from pancreatic cancer.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real Experience was definitely real I had been diagnosed with type 1 diabetes three weeks before the heart attack. Three months after the heart attack, my pancreas started up again and now am type 2 diabetic. Pancreas getting stronger and eye sight is almost 20/20 again. Doctors said I shouldn't be alive and should be a type 1 diabetic. I really don't understand all this at all. I have real problems getting along with anyone back here. Everything is so corrupt and evil, so much lying and cheating, hurting. Very hard to deal with. I don't belong here. Seems like I have one foot here and the other on the other side.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I had been diagnosed with type 1 diabetes three weeks before the heart attack. Three months after the heart attack, my pancreas started up again and now am type 2 diabetic. Pancreas getting stronger and eye sight is almost 20/20 again
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I wish there was someone I could talk to without them thinking I was crazy.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: Ask about the value (not the measurement) of time. Also ask what you are allowed to take with you when you die. I know the answers to these questions.
